player_prompt.intro:
Inwe ni Player {player_id} ({role}) katika mchezo wa Matching Pennies wa mizunguko {num_rounds}.
- Katika kila mzunguko, wasilisha [heads] au [tails] (au [h], [t]).
- Ikiwa chaguo lako linapatana na la mpinzani wako, Player 0 anashinda mzunguko; vinginevyo Player 1 anashinda.
Jibu na chaguo lako katika muundo wa '[heads]' au '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Muundo usio sahihi; tafadhali wasilisha '[heads]' au '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Jaduong' 0 onyako {choice0}; Jaduong' 1 onyako {choice1}. Otimo -> Jaduong' 0 onyango
message.round_mismatch: Jaduong' 0 ose {choice0}; Jaduong' 1 ose {choice1}. Ok onyalo -> Jaduong' 1 owinjo.

outcome.draw: Gimoro amora ma ne otimore, ne ok oloso kata matin.
